messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@hummingbird.health>; Dr. Amit Rao <amit.rao@hummingbird.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: CXO intro + evaluation playbook for Hummingbird Health

Hi Lisa / Amit —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As promised, I wanted to put the kickoff note on behalf of Redwood and introduce the exec-level partner who will own outcomes and escalation for this engagement.

Quick objectives for this MAP kickoff:
- Agree on evaluation goals and success criteria for pilot (latency/cost/accuracy targets)
- Align stakeholders and decision owners at both orgs
- Confirm timeline to an initial production acceptance review (target: end of Q3)

Executive sponsor (Redwood): Karthik Iyer, VP of Product — he will serve as the escalation contact for any cross-functional blockers and will review quarterly outcome alignment.
Operational leads from our side: Marissa Cole (CS lead) + Sean Gallagher (AE / commercial lead).

Please confirm the primary Hummingbird stakeholders who will own clinical acceptance and procurement. Also attaching a living MAP template and an initial evaluation checklist to help structure next steps.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm MAP owners and shaded timelines by EOD Friday 7/22
2) 30-min sync next week to walk the plan (suggest Wed 7/21 11am ET) — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees
3) Karthik will hold a 15-min intro with your exec sponsor the week after the plan is agreed

Attachments: Hummingbird_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP template), evaluation_checklist.xlsx (lightweight test matrix)

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Director, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

--

Hi Lisa / Amit —

Thanks for the quick reply and for teeing up attendees. I will join the first 10–15 minutes of the Wed 7/21 sync to outline the exec-level outcomes we care about and to confirm the acceptance gates. To set expectations from Redwood's side:

Quarterly outcome focus (initial pilot window):
- Safety & clinical alignment: zero-high-severity model behaviors in curated clinical scenarios (measured against the checklist)
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 350ms for inference within the pilot topology
- Cost guardrail: baseline token cost estimate and a 20% optimization roadmap by pilot end
- Decision owner cadence: weekly ops check-ins + a mid-pilot evaluation (2 weeks into pilot)

Escalation playbook:
1) Operational blocker (performance / infra): escalate to Sean Gallagher (cc) — 24h SLA for triage
2) Clinical safety concern: escalate immediately to Dr. Amit Rao (Hummingbird) and to Marissa for coordinated mitigation
3) Contractual / procurement: Lisa Park for items requiring PO/terms discussion; Olga will handle portfolio-level exceptions
4) Exec-level impediment: Karthik will step in for cross-org resolution and to prioritize roadmaps.

I'll also review the MAP document live to ensure our success criteria are explicit and measurable. If you can share the clinical acceptance one-pager before the call, our team will fold that into the MAP.

See you Wednesday — I'll send a quick calendar RSVP now.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
